interpretation_boundaries: GIS intersect at one inside-parcel point does not prove whole-lot coverage or field conditions.
County layer 79 OBJECTID 2068 predates 2026 construction and may represent historic regional flood observations. It does not establish present causation or violation.
Soil polygons are generalized; does not determine geotechnical infiltration at a structure.
A zero-result wetlands intersection at a single point is not a delineation.
A zero-result contour line intersect is expected for exact point-on-line tests; do not treat as missing elevation data.
County FEMA Zone X does not rule out local stormwater problems.
Broad basin name does not identify a functioning positive outfall.
